source.author: Dieter Bothe
source.title: On the Maxwell-Stefan approach to multicomponent diffusion
source.scope: Local isothermal isobaric ideal-gas limit. Binary MS diffusivities are friction inputs, not independent Fick coefficients in a mixture.

transport_source_settings.scope: Pure dilute-gas viscosity and first-order binary molecular diffusion only; explicit zero-dipole LJ approximation. No mixture-viscosity, porous effective diffusivity, Darcy permeability, multicomponent flux, Soret or brick qualification. GRI NASA thermo and reactions are not imported. No post-fit calibration to NIST tables. NIST comparison pressure is unspecified on selected pages; agreement is not pressure-matched experimental validation.
